# Ferdinard Ashonibare — Full-Stack Web Developer

> Personal portfolio of Ferdinard Ashonibare, a full-stack web developer in Lagos, Nigeria, building fast, secure web platforms for government, hospitality, education, and beyond. This is a personal portfolio site — not an agency.

## Education

- Diploma in Frontend Engineering — Alt School Africa, Lagos, Nigeria (2025). Core: full-cycle web development, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js
- Diploma in Web Design — HIIT Plc, Lagos, Nigeria (2024). Core: responsive web design, UI/UX principles
- Senior Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.E.) — Surulere Senior Secondary School, Lagos, Nigeria (2021)

## Currently deepening

- Deepening backend engineering — Node.js, Express & MongoDB at Ts Academy

## Proof of work

- Ogun State So-Safe Corps — official digital platform for a state security institution. Live: https://sosafecorps.og.gov.ng
- Wura Grand Hotel — premium hotel website (launching soon)
- EduTrack — education web app for tracking student progress (launching soon)
- E-Commerce Store — multi-vendor e-commerce storefront (launching soon)
- TPC Logistics — logistics landing page with a WhatsApp lead capture flow. Live: https://tpc-logistics-test.onrender.com
